Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.fact: OFDM is a frequency-division multiplexing (FDM) scheme that was introduced by Robert W. Chang of Bell Labs in 1966.

Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.subject: Telecom & Postal
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.question: In _____, the incoming bitstream representing the data to be sent is divided into multiple streams
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.fact: In telecommunications, orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) is a type of digital transmission used in digital modulation for encoding digital (binary) data on multiple carrier frequencies. OFDM has developed into a popular scheme for wideband digital communication, used in applications such as digital television and audio broadcasting, DSL internet access, wireless networks, power line networks, and 4G/5G mobile communications.

Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.subject: Telecom & Postal
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.question: Demodulation is based on fast _____ transform algorithms
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.fact: Demodulation is based on fast Fourier transform algorithms.

Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.subject: Telecom & Postal
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.question: OFDM was improved by Weinstein and Ebert in _____ with the introduction of a guard interval, providing better orthogonality in transmission channels affected by multipath propagation
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.fact: OFDM was improved by Weinstein and Ebert in 1971 with the introduction of a guard interval, providing better orthogonality in transmission channels affected by multipath propagation.

Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.subject: Telecom & Postal
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.question: Channel equalization is simplified because _____ may be viewed as using many slowly modulated narrowband signals rather than one rapidly modulated wideband signal
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.fact: The main advantage of OFDM over single-carrier schemes is its ability to cope with severe channel conditions (for example, attenuation of high frequencies in a long copper wire, narrowband interference and frequency-selective fading due to multipath) without the need for complex equalization filters. Channel equalization is simplified because OFDM may be viewed as using many slowly modulated narrowband signals rather than one rapidly modulated wideband signal.

Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.subject: Telecom & Postal
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.question: This is done to overcome errors in mobile communication channels affected by multipath propagation and _____ effects

Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.fact: In coded orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (COFDM), forward error correction (convolutional coding) and time/frequency interleaving are applied to the signal being transmitted. Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.subject: Telecom & Postal
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.question: Frequency offsets are typically caused by mismatched transmitter and receiver oscillators, or by _____ shift due to movement
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.fact: Frequency offsets are typically caused by mismatched transmitter and receiver oscillators, or by Doppler shift due to movement. While Doppler shift alone may be compensated for by the receiver, the situation is worsened when combined with multipath, as reflections will appear at various frequency offsets, which is much harder to correct.

Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.subject: Telecom & Postal
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.question: This effect typically worsens as speed increases, and is an important factor limiting the use of _____ in high-speed vehicles
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.fact: OFDM requires very accurate frequency synchronization between the receiver and the transmitter; with frequency deviation the subcarriers will no longer be orthogonal, causing inter-carrier interference (ICI) (i.e., cross-talk between the subcarriers). This effect typically worsens as speed increases, and is an important factor limiting the use of OFDM in high-speed vehicles.

Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.subject: Telecom & Postal
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.question: The receiver will then have to mimic the cyclic prefix functionality by copying the end part of the _____ symbol and adding it to the beginning portion
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.fact: The cyclic prefix, which is transmitted during the guard interval, consists of the end of the OFDM symbol copied into the guard interval, and the guard interval is transmitted followed by the OFDM symbol. The reason that the guard interval consists of a copy of the end of the OFDM symbol is so that the receiver will integrate over an integer number of sinusoid cycles for each of the multipaths when it performs OFDM demodulation with the FFT.

Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.subject: Telecom & Postal
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexi.question: In orthogonal frequency-division multiple access (_____), frequency-division multiple access is achieved by assigning different OFDM sub-channels to different users
